category: Usenet indexer (Newznab API, free browse only)

free_tier.stated: A free account is browse-only. The register page says 'Join NzbPlanet - free to browse, premium to download', and a vendor page cached in search results says 'The site is free to look around, you only need to pay for premium if you want to download nzb's'. caps declares <registration available="yes" open="no"/> and <limits max="100" default="100"/>.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an NZB pointer file

retention.stated: Free tier reported as 200 days, VIP or Platinum 2,500 days (nzbhydra.com, 2026-10-23). Not stated on the pages read from the vendor.

egress.terms: No byte metering; the API returns pointers.

interface_detail: Newznab API at /api, capped at 100 results per request. Registration is invitation-gated: the register page accepts an invitecode and rejects a bad one with 'Bad or invite code older than 7 days'.
tooling: Native Newznab on paper; in practice the key belongs to an account that cannot download without a paid tier, so Prowlarr and NZBHydra2 can add it and still get nothing useful on free.
chaining: A paid-only index from a user's position: nothing on the free side contributes to a 1 TiB/month habit.

limits.value: 0 NZB downloads on the free tier; premium required for any download
invite code required at registration; a stale code is rejected

binding_note: The first thing that fails is the download allowance, which is zero on free: not a counter that runs out but one that never starts. The invite gate sits in front of it and would bind first only if registration were open.

identity_cost.detail: Email plus an invitation. caps says open=no, and the register page's invitecode field rejects an invented code; premium signup is the documented bypass.

reliability_note: Free accounts keep full search and zero grabs, so a misconfigured arr stack sees results and fails every download rather than failing at search time.
confidence_note: The browse-only free tier and the invite gate are quoted from the vendor's own register pages read. Prices are third-party.

evidence.proved: vendor text read: 'Join NzbPlanet - free to browse, premium to download', plus the email and password rules
caps returned 200 and 7,128 bytes: title 'Nzb Planet - NZB', <limits max="100" default="100"/>, <registration available="yes" open="no"/>
unkeyed search returned <error code="200" description="Missing parameter"/>, 91 bytes, so the API needs a key
vendor page (search snippet): 'Bad or invite code older than 7 days'
third-party: VIP USD 10/year, Platinum USD 24/year, free 200 days retention, free tier '0 calls'

notes: The registerpremium page that search engines still hold returned 404 to a direct request, so its wording is cited as a snippet and not as a page read.
